title: Why Can't We Just Print More Money?

retention_map.0-3s: INSTANT HOOK: empty wallet, one coin bounces away, 'why not just print more?'
retention_map.3-10s: FIRST SURPRISE: the banker presses the button, everyone is a millionaire, then the freeze
retention_map.10-18s: ESCALATION: bread costs fifty thousand dollars; the money bag lands on his foot
retention_map.18-27s: NEW MYSTERY: more money, same bread; who wants to pay more?
retention_map.27-38s: BIG REVEAL: more money chasing the same stuff means prices can rise, that's inflation
retention_map.38-50s: COMEDY PAYOFF: a bigger printer, everybody runs, someone take away his printer
retention_map.50-60s: NEXT-EPISODE HOOK: banks can create money when they make loans; the vault opens

scenes.title: The Impossible Question
scenes.retention_hook: Instant hook: absurd empty wallet + the question the whole video answers

dialogue.text: You're broke. I'm broke. Even the government owes money. So why don't we just print more?

actions: Everyday Guy stands holding a wallet and looks worried
He turns the wallet upside down and shakes it
One tiny coin falls out, bounces three times and rolls off screen right
He looks sadly after it
Giant handwritten WHY? slams in
Fast push-in on his confused face
scenes.camera: static, then fast push-in on the face on 'why'

scenes.title: The Crazy Solution
scenes.retention_hook: First surprise: everyone is a millionaire, then a sudden freeze and silence on 'right?'
actions: Banker presses the giant red button
Printer shakes, gears spin and banknotes fly everywhere
Everyday Guy dances and jumps
On 'right?' everything freezes and the sound cuts out

scenes.title: The Unexpected Disaster
scenes.retention_hook: Escalation: bread costs fifty thousand dollars, then the bag falls on his foot

dialogue.text: That will be fifty thousand dollars.
Fifty thousand?! Is it made of gold?

actions: Everyday Guy walks into the bakery carrying a huge bag of cash
A loaf appears on the counter
The price tag flips from $5 to $50,000
His eyes widen
The money bag falls on his foot and he hops in pain

scenes.title: The Problem Gets Bigger
scenes.retention_hook: New mystery: everyone has more money but there are only ten loaves; who wants to pay more?

dialogue.text: Here's the problem. Everyone has more money, but the baker still has only ten loaves!

actions: A crowd of wealthy stick figures rushes in holding cash
Ten loaves pop onto the shelf one by one
The baker asks who wants to pay more
Everyone throws their hands up; the baker smirks

scenes.title: The Big Reveal
scenes.retention_hook: Big reveal: animated comparison, then the rich-but-poor payoff

dialogue.text: When more money chases the same amount of stuff, prices can rise. That's inflation!
So I'm rich but still poor?!

actions: Left: stacks of money keep growing
Right: the same ten loaves, never more
Price counter climbs from $5 to $50,000
Everyday Guy holds a giant cash bag; the baker hands him one tiny crumb
scenes.camera: static board, then a push-in on the characters

scenes.title: The Comedy Payoff
scenes.retention_hook: Comedy payoff: an even bigger printer; everyone runs

dialogue.text: Good news! We're printing even more money!

actions: A giant printer rolls into frame beside the banker
Banker presses the button; the printer shakes violently
Banknotes explode outward
Everyone screams and runs in different directions
The banker stays behind, confused, ankle deep in bills

scenes.title: Next-Episode Cliffhanger
scenes.retention_hook: Cliffhanger: banks can create money; the vault door opens; cut to black

dialogue.text: But here's something stranger. Banks can create money when they make loans. How does that work?

actions: Banker stands beside a locked vault; Everyday Guy points at it
The vault wheel spins and the door starts to open
Bright yellow light spills out
Hard cut to black before the contents are revealed
scenes.transition: cut to black (loops back to the red wallet scene)
